verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a cloud platform's documentation could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. Direct probes found neither, since learn.microsoft.com/llms.txt and the markdown docs variant both returned HTTP 404. The official MCP server is evidence for a separate story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
